fusions.name: Filament Garrote
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that loops a fine wire around the target, which deals 7 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spun Snare
fusions.desc: Flings out a net of spun filaments, which deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Tensioned Wire Fence
fusions.desc: Strings a fence of taut wire 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Watch-Spring Charm
fusions.desc: Coils a thousand fine strands into a watch-spring charm: your critical chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 15% more, each kill restores 3 health, and your maximum health rises by 12.
